Based on the retrieved excerpts, the specific ISO 45001 sub-clause that requires you to coordinate hazards with contractors working on your site is **clause 8.1.4**.

This clause states that "contractor activities and their workers' hazards must be coordinated and controlled with contractor-selection criteria including OH&S" (Doc 2 — clause 8.1.4).

Additionally, you should also be aware of **clause 6.1.2**, which requires ongoing hazard identification processes covering "people beside the organization's own workforce" (Doc 5 — clause 6.1.2), meaning your subcontractor crew would fall within the scope of your hazard identification obligations.
